- Grilled or seared cheese, possibly halloumi or a similar cheese, about 60 g at roughly 320 kcal per 100 g, so about 190 kcal.
- A slice of lamb or beef, about 50 g, so about 120 kcal.
- A chicken drumstick, about 70 g of edible portion, so about 140 kcal.
- Potatoes, about 70 g roasted, so about 100 kcal.
- Broccoli, about 90 g, so about 30 kcal.
- Zucchini and yellow squash, about 100 g with oil, so about 70 kcal.

That comes to about 650 kcal and 440 g of food.
